design_brief.subject: Active Sim character profile inspection (skills, preferences, traits, whims, moodlets)
design_brief.audience: player/operator discovering why a Sim wants something, plus local host agent
design_brief.job: Make the active Sim's skills, likes/dislikes, traits, aspiration, and desire cues inspectable via durable host logic — without inventing a second UI or claiming skill-growth certification

upstreams.mechanism: purpose clarity for Simology discovery job
information architecture for where to look

naming_disambiguation.sim_profile_inspector: This contract — Live Simology / skills / preferences / whims sensing
naming_disambiguation.select_sim_to_play: host-menu household picker scene (not this feature)
naming_disambiguation.compatibility_profile: game-patch certified profile under compatibility/ (not this feature)

local_observed.gap: Operator saw gardening desire/need via moodlets without knowing which HUD panels expose skills, preferences, and tendencies
local_observed.note: Moodlet strip alone is insufficient; host needs a composed Sim profile surface

player_discovery_map.player_action: Hover moodlet icons; note labels that name activities (e.g. gardening)

player_discovery_map.hud_location: Desire / whim cards near the needs panel (pack-dependent layout)
player_discovery_map.player_action: Read active whim text; cancel or pin only deliberately

player_discovery_map.hud_location: Sim Info / Simology (open from active Sim portrait or Simology tab)
player_discovery_map.player_action: Open Simology; read traits and aspiration before assuming host should queue hobbies
Check current skill levels; reading is not BI-005 skill-growth proof
Confirm whether gardening (or other hobbies) is a Like before treating a whim as personality
Survival meters still outrank hobby desires

gardening.host_note: Desire to garden is preference/whim/skill context — not automatic practice_skill authorization

cooking.host_note: Align with hunger relief when meters critical; hobby cooking is separate

fitness.host_note: Never thrash in-frame for gym when MAP_TRAVEL applies

painting.host_note: Creative whim; Fun may benefit but survival still wins

host_rules: All profile fields are operator- or sensor-supplied labels — never inferred from a screenshot classifier claim
Compose moodlets via moodlets.evaluate_moodlets; do not duplicate emotion catalogs here
Reading skill levels is NOT BI-005 skill growth, NOT practice_skill authorization, and NOT income/career proof
Do not queue hobby/skill actions solely because a whim or Like is present while survival needs are critical
Absence of all profile observations is SENSOR_NOT_SUPPLIED — do not invent traits, likes, or skills
Distinguish this inspector from host-menu select_sim_to_play and compatibility patch profiles
Player discovery map is the durable answer to 'how do I check this as a user'
